voice_058:r_479b340ccc6c572b.text: My name is Machine God Garadabura!

voice_058:r_ca4acbac57a2a35e.text: Let's see how long you can endure!

voice_058:r_70b9c4b9f1f37eff.text: I'll crush the likes of you!

voice_058:r_9fcb3754cb1773c7.text: Behold my power as a famed hero!

voice_058:r_3559d2fad32c2435.text: You shall know the might I wield!

voice_058:r_0bbe0b4f5364e732.text: I'll avenge the gods you slew!

voice_058:r_5dda5198137cb02a.text: Great God Zeus! Your life is mine!

voice_058:r_83ec59afbecdec14.text: You!\nWhy do you look like Zeus?!

voice_058:r_e20bfd42ad95a3c9.text: Zeus's double?\nThen you are my foe!

voice_058:r_0fadb5c26df92b42.text: This time, I'll finish you off!

voice_058:r_af884a6b11dff121.text: None can stand against my might!

voice_058:r_bf3244994760e535.text: Too late for regrets! It ends here!

voice_058:r_aabfb21c9d069ce7.text: Fool! You dare defy a hero?!

voice_058:r_a2df00f91a9b0a9e.text: I will not let you leave alive!

voice_058:r_48b60d6c48b9b142.text: This is the cost of defying a hero!

voice_058:r_8927e6fb681aa809.text: There's no need to fight alone!

voice_058:r_ddbe581c5ea9183d.text: Such is the price of carelessness!

voice_058:r_d4430bf362340b32.text: I'll shield you with my own body!

voice_058:r_b7b5625d7cd4282f.text: Fine. Next time, you'll get double!

voice_058:r_36133ad73a73ef98.text: Graaagh! Tch, my power is fading!

voice_058:r_920740a0219c5085.text: Hide where you will.\nI'll find you!

voice_058:r_3633df5b7b8f47fa.text: Just what are you aiming at?!

voice_058:r_52dfc56b14b93551.text: I can dodge that with ease!

voice_058:r_1b9b2aab5cb104da.text: My three heads leave no blind spot!

voice_058:r_cf41e8828a90cbdb.text: You don't live up to your boasts!

voice_058:r_719e897304ec42d4.text: Struggle all you like. It's futile!

voice_058:r_d5e0a2317c40d322.text: Even Great God Zeus is no better!

voice_058:r_ec2ea17765052401.text: You're nothing but a fake Zeus!

voice_058:r_9e6cf4f389dae55c.text: Whatever you do will be useless!

voice_058:r_47d52a2839c71715.text: The power gap is clear! No hope!

voice_058:r_857c4a52ce8df0fd.text: A hero is not defeated so easily!

voice_058:r_8fdf5910927c9591.text: I like you!\nWe'll fight to the end!

voice_058:r_7d724dbcc4451e10.text: What is the meaning of this?!

voice_058:r_adeb0a29274d3d9b.text: Y-you...! How dare you do this!

voice_058:r_8f60f6fc86db3107.text: You mimic more than Zeus's form...!

voice_058:r_3dbeead1bd3164ef.text: Grrr!\nBy my name as hero, I'll win!

voice_058:r_46e86d000250e137.text: Even if I fall here...\nI'll return!
